teleology: Convert top 1/3 of poly data into Smart Atomic Tiles with 50/50 semantic split.
instruction:
@node_path:codex/substrate/nodes/surveillance/micro_v1_poly.json
[CONTEXT]
Input: Poly Feed (Raw Data).

[TASK]
Scan the raw feed. Select the most significant ~33% of the data points (the 'Load Bearing' data).
Convert these into Smart Atomic Tiles paired with Semantic Insight.

[CONSTRAINT: SMART ATOMIC TILES]
- DO NOT repeat the data in the sentence. The data lives in the `[...]`. The sentence explains the `why`.
- DO NOT include `src` or `run_id` (we know the source).
- Ratio: 50% Data (The Tile) / 50% Semantics (The Context).

[FORMAT EXAMPLE]
Bad: "Apple is up 5% to 150 [id:AAPL p:150 chg:5%]" (Redundant)
Good: "[id:AAPL p:150 chg:+5% v:10m] Safe-haven flows are rotating back into mega-cap tech despite yield pressure."
Good: "[id:si-hit-100 p:0.75 c:0.15] Longer horizon restores upside optionality even if end-Jan is faded."

[OUTPUT]
Stream of Atomic Tiles covering the top 1/3 of the feed.
expectation: Stream of Atomic Tiles covering the top 1/3 of the feed.
